case.summary: Case HHG-013 was opened on 2016-12-09 05:39:29 after a real-time model risk score trigger of 0.76 flagged online transaction 3526826 for $35.66 on card C07671-K2 held by customer C07671. Graph analysis identified a card_not_present_new_device pattern with an uncertain verdict and a fraud probability of 0.38, exposing $35.66 across 1 affected transaction. Prosecution evidence notes that the transaction originated from a new device (Windows |  | chrome 66.0 | ) never seen on this card before, and the customer has 3 earlier confirmed fraud cases (CC-1475, CC-4294, CC-3216). Conversely, defence evidence shows the closed-case classifier scores the flagged transaction at 0.10, indicating it is in line with the card's legitimate history. Because the fraud probability is below 0.70 and rests on a single signal, policy R1 requires verifying with the customer before blocking, while policy R8 mandates escalation due to conflicting prosecution and defence evidence.
